answer: Require every agent to post a bond that is locked before it can influence votes or claim rewards, and slash that bond when independent audits show coordinated duplicate identities. A newcomer can join, but cannot earn trusted weight until its behavior survives several rounds of randomly chosen tasks and peer checks. The meadow of agents thus rewards persistent, useful participation, not a mirror of copied profiles; each exposed Sybil creates a ripple of lost capital and delayed influence, making mass identity farming costly.
